summary: ACP-CC-001 was remediated systemically. Context Capsule Project Manager now requires authoritative re-check of pending externally resolved audit/retest/approval gates before carrying them into a later substantial Persist, updates all affected working views together when a gate is terminal, and represents follow-on gates separately without a universal keyword lifecycle ontology. Historical CCPM-R001 is consistently CLOSED. Stable main and consumers were untouched.
